facts.fact: 空中救援：Nikolas 光速接住塔坠者（有的挣扎、有的感恩、更多昏迷或已死）；Angelica/Yvri 从附身中挣出（她按着流血的额角）。
门开：白光柱立在宫殿广场中央、直指 Phos 之眼——Solara；Angelica 命他走（Get—away / Go）。
掐喉：认出 Rian 剪影+闻到血与丁香午夜——Again. Again. AGAIN.——光速俯冲掐住 Dante 喉、矛尖抵其裸胸：「Is this all the Lastriders are good for? Using others for their own ends?」；Rian 流血喊「It’s all right. I told you—」。
闪回：12 岁/14 岁夏至节棕榈树下初遇——「I’ve always been jealous of the Cyrs during summertime」——少年 Nikolas 回以微笑；如今的阴影只准备报复。

Dante 自辩：「If I didn't do this...there would be a worse price to pay. You think you're the only one with something to lose? I left my mother bleeding out on the floor.」——「We have to stop them. Before we lose any more. I'll do anything I have to, even if it means going through you.」
facts.anchor: “I left my mother bleeding out on the floor.”

facts.fact: 威胁与反问：Nikolas 平静下杀意——「If you lay a hand on him again, I will kill you」；Dante 懒笑反问：「Is that your plan for when we find Taesia?」——他没有召唤恶魔。
facts.anchor: “If you lay a hand on him again,”

facts.fact: 收束：矛辉史上最亮（fulcrum 感应到门后的 godkind）；Rian 眼中的答案=花园之问（help or revenge）——「Dante was right—they still had so much to lose. And he had so much to be forgiven for.」
facts.anchor: The Sunbringer Spear shone brighter than it ever had

facts.fact: Angelica 自救线：以痛关火（大腿一割如 Mount Netsai）——「She's gone」——锁门闭第三眼；Yvri「She played you」——「And I let her」——「Then we will end her」；托家去 Azuna（「Only because you said please」）；Cosima 穿门而回（「I chose you」）递回琴盒——「Maybe in Solara, she could destroy something worthwhile.」
